List all job resources.

## Synopsis

```text
.jobs [type=<type>] [enabled | disabled]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints the names of all Job resources of the Director configuration, one per line, for completion of job= and selection lists. Only jobs allowed by the console's Job ACL appear, in configuration order. It reads only the configuration.

type= compares only the first letter of its value, case-sensitively, with the job type letter (B Backup, R Restore, V Verify, D Admin, c Copy, g Migrate, O Consolidate, A Archive); so type=Backup works but type=backup returns nothing. enabled and disabled filter as for .clients.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type=` | resource | from [`.types`](../dot-types/) |  |  | Job type. |
| `enabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only enabled resources. |
| `disabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only disabled resources. |

## Examples

List the backup jobs:

```text
.jobs type=Backup
```

List only disabled jobs:

```text
.jobs disabled
```
